description: Written-terminator priority adds no check of its own, but a changed answer can make another condition run. Under priority, begins of r is false on A B T, so the implication goes on to matches of loop. loop asks about its own span as itself, which is the error of a recursive query (engine §4).
grammar:
%elidable T
%rule text A B T
%conditions (¬begins(from($), r)) ⟹ matches($, loop)
%rule r A c [T] T
%rule c B
%rule loop A B T
%conditions matches($, loop)
